notes.title: Just Act Natural: Museum DLC OUT NOW!!!!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544070]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544070[/url]

Dinosaurs! Gladiators! Vikings!

Discover all this and more in the new MUSEUM stage in the first-ever DLC for Just Act Natural! The MUSEUM DLC comes with a new hand-sculpted stage that you can play on in EVERY Just Act Natural game mode as well as all kinds of history-themed cosmetics!

[u][b]BIG RUBY [/b][/u]

The Museum stage features the Big Ruby in several different game modes. Hider players can STEAL this Ruby both in Diamond Grab AND other game modes to score big points.

However, doing so will activate SECURITY GATES, cutting off the stealer from escaping across the stage for a short time.

Features:
• [b]New[/b] hand-sculpted Museum stage for all Just Act Natural Game Modes!
• Shared access for every player your lobby, even if they don't own the DLC!
• [b]New[/b] hand-sculpted cosmetics for Hider players!
• [b]New[/b] hand-sculpted ‘Pterodactyl’ Seeker avatar
• [b]New[/b] Museum-themed lobby icons and name cards


I'm really excited to finally be having new content out for Just Act Natural, depending on how this goes I'd love to make some more DLC maps over the summer! This is a great way to support more JAN development as well as development of our next upcoming game! I hope you guys enjoy the new map and, as always, any ideas for improvements/ bug fixes PLEASE let me know and I'd be happy to work on them 🙂

notes.title: v1.1.0 VISUAL UPDATE + MAINTENANCE
notes.notes:
It's been awhile, but it's time for another update, version 1.1.0. Just Act Natural is getting some polish! We're working on cleaning up the menus and making it easier to find the games and settings you want. Now you can more easily filter game modes, change advanced options, and there's even a search bar to help find your friends' games. Going forward we look to get back on track with regular bi-weekly / monthly content updates. As always, Discord is the best place to make suggestions, report bugs and get in contact with the dev-team. Click [url=https://discord.com/invite/X7BcZUDhzc]HERE [/url]to join.


Few items of the changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed BOLT crashing screen on startup
[*] Fixed default region miss-matches
[*] Region handling improvements
[*] User Interface Improvements
- Session browser
- Lobby interface
- Settings menu
[*] Under the hood stuff
- New data management system (cross-platform compatibility)
- Codebase refactoring
- Pipeline improvements
[/list]

Thank you for your continued patience. We hope to bring you Just Act Natural to more platforms soon!!

- Lee (current captain)

notes.title: v1.0.84 NEW GAMEMODE: "Goose on the Loose"!
notes.notes:
NEW GAMEMODE: ‘GOOSE ON THE LOOSE’ OUT NOW! 

It’s been awhile, but I am excited to finally announce we have released update v1.0.84. With this comes some long-awaited bug fixes, small QOL improvements and the new ‘Goose on the Loose’ game mode!

In “Goose On the Loose” players play as bread, collecting coins around the map for points. They need to watch out for the secret KILLER GOOSE hidden among the NPC geese around them. If they get eaten they become a goose themselves!

This update also includes:

•Fixes to the ‘HeadHunters’ disappearing hat glitch
•Fix broken unlockable outfits for spaceship unlocks
•Adjust pointer for Lazar mouth seeker skin
•Fix XP limit to ~4000

I know it’s been awhile, thanks for your patience. I hate waiting this long to update things and hope to get back to more frequent, smaller updates and patches.

We’re working on a bunch of exciting new content for JAN this summer, including additional game modes that I hope to have before the summer’s end. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.78
notes.notes:
Hey guys! v1.0.78 is out now! Focused on fixing glitches for this update, but in addition we added the ability to kick players mid-match 🙂

So this update includes some major changes behind the scenes to the xp system(kinda why this update took so long to get out). We needed to do this to combat the cheating and fix some of the issues associated with the xp progress. Unfortunately it saves on a different system than before so you'll notice some of your progress will be wiped. Don't freak out yet though, we're working on some stuff this week to get your previous xp back in some form but there's still stuff that will need to be reset. The good news is this system is much more sustainable and we just needed to bite the bullet once and now what we got is a lot better for the long term continued development of Just Act Natural 😄

I hope you understand! ❤️

- Conor

notes.title: Plans for 1.0 and beyond
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We are rapidly approaching 1.0 and I thought I’d share my plans for full release and beyond!

First just wanna thank you for being part of this game’s development and giving ideas and feedback. It’s been really great having you to go to whenever I have new ideas or concepts to try out 🙂 It’s been a lot of fun hearing your ideas and suggestions as well! It’s definitely been a great learning experience for me and I hope it’s been fun for you guys to see the game grow over the past year!

Plans for JAN as I approach 1.0:

So recently we hit v0.9.5 with the update allowing a rotating weekly free game mode. From there the following weeks I will be primarily focusing only on bug fixes, QOL improvements and polish. 

I plan on hitting 1.0 on [u][b]March 25th[/b][/u]. With the full release, based on your feedback, I think it’s fair to raise the price of premium to [i][u][b]$8 USD[/b][/u][/i]? (There will still be the free version of course!)

After 1.0:

As far as my plans for JAN AFTER 1.0, frankly, I’m not sure. I’ve been really grinding on this for a while and very much need a long break. I still think there’s plenty of cool game mode/stage ideas that could be added to the future but right now I don’t want to promise anything like DLC until I figure out my next steps in life. 

What I WILL promise, of course, is bug fixes as they come up. I’ll be working a temporary full time job starting at the end of the month so the updates will be slower than they have been but I’ll be sure to add small updates when I can 🙂

Also our community manager @Zakton (Brent) will still be working on getting more eyes on the game and more players in 🙂
I’ll be sure to post again here when I figure out my next steps, so if you’re interested in my future work(on JAN or otherwise) I’d like it if you stuck around 🙂 And ofc the discrod will still be there to post ideas and find matches. 

So that’s pretty much it. Does this sound good to you? Don’t want anyone to feel cheated or anything

-Conor

notes.title: New Game Mode: 'Kill The King' out now!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Happy to announce we've just released Just Act Natural's fifth game mode: Kill The King!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/osALqon.gif[/img]

In this game mode Hiders work as a team against the Seekers to kill the NPC king and his nobles before time runs out. Shot Hiders are sent to JAIL where they can be freed by a fellow hider. Seekers must keep the King or any of his nobles alive until the match ends!

Look forward to even more game modes coming soon!

- Conor

notes.title: An Important Update On Our Monetization Plans!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. Wanted to give you an update on our monetization plans.

We’ve seen some push back, and after thinking about it all month, we’ve decided to make it so [b]**ALL PLAYERS WILL HAVE ACCESS TO NEW MAPS/MODES IF THE HOST IS PREMIUM**[/b]. We think right now it’s better for everyone if we make everything as accessible as possible.

“Wait but me and my friends already bought the paid version! Is it just worthless now as long as we have one of us with premium?!? :angry: Gamer angry!” : so premium version still gets you the cosmetic stuff like it does now, as well as the future cosmetic stuff in the works(seeker skins, unlockable outfits, etc). Does that sound good?

All of this will be going into effect next *[b]Friday, Oct 1st[/b]*. The game will remain $5, because of this change we may change it to $10 at version 1.0, but idk that’s still several months away so we’ll see. 

Thanks for everyone’s feedback and patience this last month, I'm new at this business stuff. But I feel this is the best way forward for everyone :) I hope you agree!

xoxox

-Conor

notes.title: Just Act Natural Premium Version Out Now!!
notes.notes:
Alright! The time has come! The Just Act Natural Premium Version is now available!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GKDbUde.gif[/img]

Featuring 3 New game modes, the new Castle map, and access to all the additional content that will be added the next few months!

In [b]ASSASSINS [/b]all players are HIDERS and must find and kill the other players without revealing themselves.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wixjY2e.gif[/img]

In [b]DEATH RACE[/b] Hider players must race each other to the finish line without being too eager and revealing themselves to the Seeker above!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dVkGWcz.gif[/img]

In addition, this version launches with PARTY MODE, which combines all the game modes together randomly!

Finally, the new hand-sculpted CASTLE stage has been added. Walk around as knights and wizards hiding from the Seeker placed in the MIDDLE of the stage!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XS1ttjY.gif[/img]

The Premium Version can be downloaded as DLC on the main page :D

Few changes from our original plans due to your feedback:

>Originally we were gonna have free players be on a separate server from premium players. After thinking about it some more, we decided to just have all players on one server. Realistically the premium player base may be small at the start, and we didn’t want to punish those who are supporting development by not being able to find games on the premium server. So how it works is you just wont be able to play any premium content if there are players in the party who don’t have premium, but premium players can join any lobby freely.

In addition, Lee and I are now able to do marketing efforts for the game to get new players in. That said, I’m gonna be honest, it might be a little bumpy at first. As we add more and more to this game I think we’ll get more and more premium players, but you may have to rely on this discord to set up premium matches at first. Not sure exactly what to expect, but just keep that in mind 

Thanks to everyone in this community for supporting development thus far :) You guys are seriously the best, I hope you’re as excited for the future of this game as we are!

I love you xoxoxoxoxo

-Conor

notes.title: Our Current Plans for Monetization
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I wanted to talk quick about our current plans for monetization

As you may have noticed by the lack of any in game shop or ads in a game that’s F2P, we didn’t really think through the “How we gonna make money?” aspect when we were developing the game. We sorta just focused on making the game we wanted. But now we’re in a tough spot where we can’t really afford to get a bunch of more players in server-wise without some sort of model in place. So Lee and I have been trying to figure out the best way to do that.

Here’s what we’ve come up with: 

The game, as you currently know it(with additional QOL additions and bug fixes) will remain FREE. We’re thinking there will be a paid version of the game($5) that will have the additional stages and game mode(s) that we’re adding in the future. I think that’s the best way to do it? Otherwise it’s keeping it free with in-game microtransactions, but that’s a lot of time spent making stuff that doesn’t improve the game on our end and even then I don’t think we have too much of a set up for compelling things to sell(Seeker skins, pins? I'd rather have those as future unlockables) This way people pay once and don’t have to worry about paying for all the additional content :).

We plan on launching this paid version with two new game modes and the new castle map on [i][b]Friday, August 27th[/b][/i]

Important side notes: We'll be giving out plenty of keys to active discord members when this happens. AND We will be running a Buy One Get One Free deal for the paid version when we first launch :).

Of course, this isn’t set in stone. So let us know what you think. This is the best we’ve been able to come up with.  We’re two dudes in our rooms making the game we wanna make, not some big studio trying to grab all the money from you they can, so feel free to express your concerns or thoughts on this plan in the Discussions tab. You guys have all been super supportive, and we don’t want you to feel cheated or anything. 

Thanks 
- Conor

notes.title: Update Version 0.3.0 - Donkeys, Join Game Mid-Match, QOL Updates, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xr2sMbZ.gif[/img]

Okay! Hi! It’s been a while! Thanks for being so patient! We got a bunch of highly requested quality of life features and (most importantly) donkeys!


[u][b]Biggest Added Features[/b][/u]
-Resolution Options
-Join a game mid-match[BETA](you no longer need to wait until they return to lobby to join!)
-Spawn as fun alternatives to humans on various stages!
-In game score screen(open at any time with TAB)
-Equipped Items are saved between matches
-Option to set the desired amount of Ammo for the seeker(up to unlimited)
-Cleaner and updated UI

We have also fixed most of the current reported bugs(you can see the full detailed list on our  [url=https://trello.com/b/IOY9wcdk/jan-to-do]Trello Board[/url]). I understand that there’s been a lot of difficulty with connecting to matches/ your friends. We’ve added more detailed error messages, but from what we can tell most of the cause is trying to connect to a match when the server is at its limit. Right now we can only have 100 people online at any point, and we are going over that pretty often, which I frankly didn’t think would happen for a while. Especially on weekends, we have 200-300 playing online(which means more than half wont be able to connect o_O) which is super frustrating I'm sure. Lee and I are figuring out how to monetize the game so that we can afford to upgrade our servers. We’ll share our ideas probably tomorrow and we can figure out what’s best together . Thanks for your patience with it guys.

notes.title: JAN v0.2 OUT NOW! New Stage, Bug Fixes, QOL upgrades!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QjL1i1A.gif[/img]

HELLO EVERYONE! We have just released the long awaited version 0.2.0! There’s quite a lot of improvements and changes. Here’s some of the bigger ones:

>New Stage[Beta]: Sushi City. 
>Hiders can now see each other in-match
>Control mapping options
>New Lobby that allows everyone to see who’s readied up, allows the host to kick players, has a chatbox and region display
>”AMMO” for the seeker that no longer allows Seeker to just keep shooting everything
>A LOT of bug fixes :) (thanks for your reports!)

Most of the work was under the hood, we restructured everything to make bug fixes a lot smoother in the future and in the process removed a lot of the bugs that have been reported. That said, it might’ve caused some new bugs to pop up. Be sure to let us know in the coming days if you find anything and we’ll get right on it :)

Thanks for your continued support. We know it’s been hard to find matches, once we get things a little more stable and add more content we’ll focus more on marketing to get new players in :)
